name: reasoning
description: Collapsible panel for a model’s reasoning — opens and shimmers "Thinking…" while it streams, then settles to "Thought for N seconds"

meta.name: Reasoning
meta.description: Collapsible panel for a model’s reasoning — opens and shimmers "Thinking…" while it streams, then settles to "Thought for N seconds"

props.name: streaming
props.description: True while reasoning is still arriving: the panel opens, the trigger shimmers "Thinking…" and the content is aria-busy. Turning it off closes the panel.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds spent reasoning. Once streaming ends the trigger reads "Thought for {duration} seconds"; without it, "Reasoning". The caller owns the clock.

props.name: label
props.description: Replaces the trigger text in every state.

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides for the component’s user-visible strings (i18n). `thoughtFor` may contain `{count}`.
props.type: { thinking?: string; thoughtFor?: string; label?: string }

examples.title: Streaming
examples.code: <Reasoning streaming>The user wants a summary, so I will start with the totals…</Reasoning>

examples.title: Settled
examples.code: <Reasoning duration={12}>The user wants a summary, so I started with the totals and then compared regions.</Reasoning>

whenToUse: Showing a model’s reasoning or thinking trace above its answer, collapsed once the answer arrives
Giving readers an opt-in look at how an AI reached a result without cluttering the reply
whenNotToUse: General show/hide content — use Collapsible or Accordion
A sequence of discrete agent steps with their own status — use Steps or Timeline
Reporting the phase of a request — use AiStatus

antiPatterns.bad: Wrapping the reasoning text in aria-live so it is read as it streams
antiPatterns.good: <Reasoning streaming> — the content is aria-busy and silent; pair it with AiStatus for the phase
antiPatterns.why: Announcing every token of a reasoning trace drowns out everything else

related.name: ShimmerText
related.reason: The streaming trigger label is ShimmerText

related.name: AiStatus
related.reason: AiStatus announces the phase while Reasoning holds the trace

intent.a11yRationale: Built on native <details>/<summary>, so the trigger is a keyboard-operable disclosure (Enter/Space) with its expanded state exposed by the browser, it works before hydration, and find-in-page can open it. The content carries aria-busy while streaming and is never a live region; the sparkle is decorative and pulses only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference

content.tone: The trigger names the state — "Thinking…" while working, "Thought for 12 seconds" after

flexibility.note: Override with label, or localise each state through labels
Opens when streaming starts and closes when it ends; do not force it open after the answer arrives
